source: docs/swarm/model-tier-rulings.md (user ruling 2026-10-05) + CLIProxyAPIPlus/docs/flagship-coverage.md (AA Intel benchmark snapshot, 2026-10-05)
benchmark: AA Intel = Artificial Analysis Intelligence index; higher is stronger. 'same-or-stronger' = aaIntel >= the role's floorAaIntel.
note: EXPLICIT ALIAS TABLE (one term, one meaning, machine form): each model lists its EXACT catalog id spellings. Identity is by EXACT equality against an alias (a trailing -<date> suffix is tolerated), NEVER a substring — so claude-opus-5 can never pass as claude-opus-5-5, nor sonnet-5.5-mini inherit sonnet-5.5. Recommended = baseline, not a closed whitelist: a self-selected catalog model that is a benchmarked, same-or-stronger model (aaIntel >= floor) + a {chosen, why, benchmark} record is accepted. Updating this is a user ruling, not a code change.
